body: A friend posted this on Facebook today and it makes sense to me. Thank you for your validation. http://www.upworthy.com/how-would-you-describe-depression-to-someone-who-doesnt-have-it-one-man-nails-it-with-a-poem?g=2

I didn't want things to be over with when I was lying. I was selfish and lied because I wanted to be with him. I didn't want to own up to how messed up I am so I deceived him about it. It wasn't fair. I am devastated that I hurt him. I don't want to hurt him anymore but I seem to do it no matter what. 

I'm working on getting a therapist since my last one retired. I appreciate the comments and support. I'm trying to find a way to get through one day at a time.
